retrievalProfile.description: A centered circular photographic window set against a flat, warm yellow background with top-aligned, wide-tracked serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist layout featuring a large central circular aperture containing a high-contrast sunset photograph, framed by a thin teal and black border, set on a solid pale yellow field with two levels of top-aligned text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central circular focal point against a flat rectangular field
High-contrast warm sunset colors vs. cool teal framing
Wide horizontal text alignment balancing the vertical center of the circle
Thin geometric border lines defining the outer and inner margins
coreInvariants: Thin teal and black concentric circular stroke
Top-aligned typography with extreme letter spacing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The circular image is the primary subject, centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 50% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun flare within the dark circular frame acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the secondary text line, and settles into the central circular image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the solid yellow background creates a clean, retro-minimalist feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark silhouettes within the circle
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red sunset and thin teal circular border
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central image contrasted against low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Custom swash on the letter 'C' that descends below the baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' features a long, curved tail that acts as a divider
The 'H' and 'E' have elongated horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a blocky, widely spaced sans-serif for the secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the small-serif, wide-proportion feel of the display text.
Captures the 70s serif aesthetic and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat pale yellow background with a thin black rectangular border. In the center, place a large circle containing a high-contrast sunset photograph with a dark silhouette and a bright sun flare. Frame the circle with a thin teal and black concentric line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text at the top. The first line should be a wide-tracked serif in all caps. The second line should be a smaller, bold sans-serif with extreme letter spacing spanning the width of the circle.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent pale yellow?
Is the text white and all-caps?
Is the tracking on the second line of text extremely wide?

mustRedesign: Exact photographic content of the sunset
Unique swash on the letter C

mustAchieve: High-contrast lighting in the central image

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teal border is a thin, clean line.
Check that the text does not touch the circular frame.
Verify the sunset image has a distinct 'glow' effect.
Confirm the overall color palette feels warm and vintage.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered circular window + flat color field + wide-tracked top typography = Retro Album Aesthetic
